scenario: Postgres connection exhaustion — orders-api scaled 3 → 8 with a 20-connection pool each, past postgres-primary max_connections
query: why are orders-api pods not ready
notes: orders-api was scaled from 3 to 8 replicas; each pod opens a pool of 20 connections, so 160 > the 100 max_connections of postgres-primary. The three replicas started last cannot connect: Running but not Ready (the /ready probe pings the database), Deployment 5/8. Each signal carries one piece and none names all of it: Prometheus shows the database saturated (100/100, most slots held by orders-api) and the 5xx rate; Loki shows the refused connections on the not-ready pods (remaining connection slots are reserved, pool timeout); OTel shows POST /orders failing in db.connect. One decoy per signal, each testing a filter h013-h015 do not: an OrdersApiHighErrorRate alert in staging for a deployment of the same name (dropped by the namespace check in PrometheusCollector._find_entity), a Ready catalog-api pod with ERROR log lines (not queried: LokiSource only selects pods that need telemetry), and an orders-api error trace from staging (dropped by the namespace filter on trace search). Spec: docs/test-cases.md, Broadened offline coverage section 4.
